controlled_gmm.global_exploration_policy: current controlled-mixture rows must report not_established

estimand_definitions.marginal_amortized: chain output divided by its sampling gradients plus one M-th share of joint warmup gradients
estimand_definitions.one_output_total: one chain output divided by its sampling gradients plus all joint warmup gradients
estimand_definitions.pooled_population_total: pooled-chain ESS divided by all warmup and sampling gradients

efficiency.primary_reporting_gate: pooled ratios are emitted only when automatic and comparator population quality gates both pass

restart_ablation.claim_policy: descriptive paired ratios only; no equivalence claim without a predeclared equivalence margin

schedule_configuration.interpretation: configuration comparison; schedule changes boundaries and dual-averaging cadence

shared_step_size.comparison_scope: shipped controller bundles: historical sequential/uncapped versus current mean-pooled/warmup-depth-capped

traceability.number_source_policy: manuscript numbers are generated from this frozen summary and its checksummed raw inputs
